#   Chem. 94 (2022) 573); eight elements without one carry the mass number of a long-lived isotope.
# I_eV: mean excitation energy of the element (eV), ICRU Report 37 (1984) values as used by NIST PSTAR/ASTAR
#   (ICRU Report 49, 1993); for H, He, N, O, F, Ne, Cl, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn the gas value.
# phase: the state of the element at room temperature and pressure (solid, liquid, gas).
